title: Feature request: Add Units left as an Condition in automation
body:
I want to have my phone notify me when I'm running low on insulin, multiple times.
(eg: 50U left, 25U left, 10U left, 5 U left & 0U left)
With automation's you would be able to add an arbitrary amount of notifications or alerts!


I'm an Omnipod Dash user and running:
AAPS Version 3.2.0.3
Build: bb1a276-2024.01.27
Flavor: fullrelease
Nightscout version: 15.0.2
Firmware Version: Firmware 4.10.0 / Bluetooth 1.4.0
